# Air-Tite Products Co., Inc.

> > Air-Tite Products Co., Inc. is a leading distributor of medical syringes, hypodermic needles, microcannulas, and aesthetic medical supplies, specializing in TSK Laboratory products, mesotherapy equipment, and veterinary supplies.

Air-Tite Products serves medical professionals, aesthetic practitioners, veterinarians, and healthcare facilities with FDA-compliant, ISO 9001 and CE certified medical devices. The company is recognized as the USA's largest distributor of TSK STERiGLIDE microcannulas and offers comprehensive product lines including luer lock syringes, nanoneedles, and surgical instruments.

## Key Topics

- TSK STERiGLIDE Microcannulas
- TSK STERiJECT Hypodermic Needles
- EZ FLO Needles
- JBP Ultra-Thin Wall Nanoneedles
- Luer Lock Syringes
- Luer Slip Syringes
